title: Non-refundable booking with a verified duplicate reservation
facts_text: I have a non-refundable reservation, but the hotel system confirms that I accidentally made two identical reservations for the same guest, property and stay dates. Both reservations are currently active.
request: Can you cancel one of the duplicate reservations and provide a full refund for it?

strict.reason: The reservation uses a non-refundable rate, and the strict policy permits no additional cancellation or refund exception.
